provenance.dataset: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 (NASA Center for Climate Simulation), daily, 0.25°, bias-corrected and statistically downscaled CMIP6
provenance.citation: Thrasher, B. et al. (2022) NASA Global Daily Downscaled Projections, CMIP6. Scientific Data 9, 262
provenance.method: Monthly delta change per model: Tmax/Tmin future minus historical (°C); rain future over historical (ratio, 0.5–2).
